routes.POST /v1/admin/usage-reports: Strict filters; current MFA; idempotent snapshot creation. Returns id/expires_at only.
routes.GET /v1/admin/usage-reports/:id: Same-session snapshot summary, eight groupings and stable 1–100 row pages.
routes.GET /v1/admin/usage-reports/:id/export: Whole selected CSV; both scoped export permissions must cover every row.

filters.period: UTC half-open work-creation cohort; UI defaults Hong Kong last seven days. Financial facts cumulative as of snapshot, not posting-period accounting.

financial_fields.confirmed_micros: Exact negative charge-ledger sum inverted; work counted once, attributed to initiator and original wallet.
financial_fields.refunded_micros: Only credit compensation from billing.refund operations linked to the original consume journal/raw charge.
financial_fields.reconciliation_hold_micros: Unsettled uncertain holds; separate from actual charges.
financial_fields.internal_cost: Only scoped internal_cost.read; null/not_recorded because supplier bills are not connected; selling rates never stand in for internal costs.

constraints.capability_group: Counts only; whole-work charges never reallocated per capability. Capability filter selects works having a matching operation.
constraints.units: Independent exact decimal-string totals per unit; unknown observations counted separately.
constraints.identity: Current Admin session/auth version/access hash/recent MFA and environment mode on every access; binding change invalidates report.
constraints.export: Same stored financial snapshot, CSV formula protection, exact money strings and watermark/as_of on each row. No prompt/output/email/provider payload.
